package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStatus string

const (
	TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStatus = "message_pending"
	TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered      TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStatus = "delivered"
)

// TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession is the bounded, immutable replay evidence
// for a direct ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS result. It deliberately stores no path,
// course, lesson, answers, UI, body, or model data.
type TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession struct {
	ID                       string
	StudentID                string
	PersonalTeacherID        string
	DialogID                 string
	SessionSchemaVersion     int
	StateRef                 TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef
	TerminalKind             TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Status
	TerminalMessageCommandID string
	Status                   TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStatus
	DialogMessageID          string
	CreatedAt                time.Time
	UpdatedAt                time.Time
	DeliveredAt              time.Time
}

func NewTeacherOnboardingActivePathTerminalSession(teacher PersonalTeacher, binding TeacherDialogBinding, stateRef TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, now time.Time) (TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error) {
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	stateRef, refErr := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(stateRef)
	if err != nil || refErr != nil || stateRef.Kind == TeacherReadinessStateNone || teacher.ID != binding.PersonalTeacherID || teacher.StudentID != binding.StudentID || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return NormalizeTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{
		ID:        DeterministicOnboardingUUID("active-path-terminal-session", binding.ID, stateRef.Kind, stateRef.Version),
		StudentID: teacher.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, DialogID: binding.ID,
		SessionSchemaVersion: 3, StateRef: stateRef, TerminalKind: TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists,
		TerminalMessageCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("active-path-terminal-message", binding.ID, stateRef.Kind, stateRef.Version),
		Status:                   TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending, CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC(),
	})
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(input TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) (TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.TerminalMessageCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TerminalMessageCommandID)
	input.DialogMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogMessageID)
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	input.DeliveredAt = input.DeliveredAt.UTC()
	stateRef, err := NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef)
	if err != nil || stateRef.Kind == TeacherReadinessStateNone || !validUUID(input.ID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.TerminalMessageCommandID) ||
		input.SessionSchemaVersion != 3 || input.TerminalKind != TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.StateRef = stateRef
	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending:
		if input.DialogMessageID != "" || !input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() {
			return TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingTerminalDelivered:
		if !validUUID(input.DialogMessageID) || input.DeliveredAt.IsZero() || input.DeliveredAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.DeliveredAt) {
			return TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return input, nil
}
